definitions.explanation: A long, belted raincoat with a double-breasted front, originally military wear. A classic piece of spring and autumn outerwear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧トレンチコート⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{似合|にあ}う→似合う：02134_niau⟧。
examples.english: He looks good in a trench coat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧になった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧でトレンチコート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Spring has come, so I took out my trench coat.

examples.japanese: ベージュ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧トレンチコート⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせ→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧やすい。
examples.english: A beige trench coat is easy to match with any clothes.

notes:
A belted, double-breasted coat, traditionally beige. Worn as a light coat in spring and autumn rather than deep winter.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- トレンチコート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{羽織|はお}る→羽織る：13901_haoru⟧: to throw on a trench coat
- ⟦ベルト→ベルト：01508_beruto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{締|し}める→締める：10057_shimeru⟧: to fasten the belt
- ベージュ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧トレンチコート: a beige trench coat

USAGE:
トレンチコート is considered a timeless, slightly formal item suitable for office and smart-casual wear.
